description: This file implements the FilesystemCache class, which provides a filesystem-based caching mechanism for Twig templates, including methods for generating cache keys, loading, writing, removing cache files, and managing cache invalidation.

classes.name: FilesystemCache
classes.description: Implements a filesystem-based cache for Twig, including cache key generation, loading, writing, removal, and invalidation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a directory path and options.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a cache file path based on a given name and class name.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and includes a cache file if it exists.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes content to a cache file, creating directories as needed and handling bytecode invalidation if configured.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cache file based on the provided name and class name.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the modification time of a cache file.
